reason: I do one big shop a week and keep the list in my head, it works fine. I would not hand my family's receipts and data to an app I have never heard of, and I would not pay monthly for something I can do myself.
objection: I don't trust an app with my family's data, and scanning every receipt sounds like extra work I would stop doing after a week.
would_change_my_mind: A clear promise in Arabic that my receipts and household data stay private, plus the free version proving useful for a few weeks before I ever pay.
